method: Actual list and detail-panel browser captures; a frame-driven SVG reconstruction for the folder morph, continuous orthographic camera, workflow/asset geometry, animated connectors and selection. Not a continuous screen recording.

files.list.jpg: Full workflow list; shell cropped at render time.
files.map-overview.jpg: Saved folder layout in the actual 3D product view.
files.folder-selected.jpg: Reference capture: Lead Capture folder contents.
files.workflow-focus.jpg: Unselected workflow and linked assets, at close scale.
files.workflow-selected.jpg: Actual workflow details and asset groups.
files.asset-expanded.jpg: Actual expanded Program Application asset showing its trigger.

reconstructionScope: Five verified folder names, all five verified Lead Capture workflow names, and the four verified assets associated with Program Application Submitted. Other folders provide spatial context; this is an explanatory reconstruction, not an export of the complete live map layout.
icons: Existing local @iconify-json/mdi package; corresponding product icon identifiers. Paths copied into src/video/StructureIcons.ts.
